
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Returns the index of the first truthy element in a one-dimensional double-
    precision complex floating-point ndarray.

    If unable to find a truthy element, the function returns `-1`.

    A complex number is truthy when at least one of its real or imaginary
    components is truthy.

    The function treats `NaN` values as falsy.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a one-dimensional input ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: integer
        Index.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/complex128}}( [ 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 2.0 ] );
    > {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    1

    See Also
    --------
